schema_version: 1
name: ms-go-tz-planner
service_kind: backend_service
repository_role: practice_task_authoring_owner
purpose: Convert raw task intent or imported manifests into verified, versioned TechnicalTask aggregates and Practice-compatible TaskBlueprint artifacts.
owns:
  - authoring job lifecycle, leases, idempotency, and provenance
  - task analysis, decomposition, intrinsic difficulty, steps, requirements, evaluation intent, review and assistance policy
  - strict TaskBlueprint candidate quality gates
  - trusted PII-free authoring orchestration intent and exact authored practice/project surface
  - technical-task.v1 projection, invariants, and trusted/student read models
does_not_own:
  - published practice-task catalog revisions
  - competency catalog or student learning routes
  - student progress, workspaces, validation execution, teacher dialogs, or evidence mastery
  - deriving desired difficulty from student-owned data or starting Practice instances
dependencies:
  - ms-go-learning-planner: bounded canonical target discovery plus exact target resolution
  - ms-go-sandbox: runtime profile catalog and isolated verification workspaces
  - ms-go-validation-orchestrator: capability inspection and executable verification
  - ms-go-ai-prompt: schema-constrained candidate generation
  - ms-go-practice-task-orchestrator: private verified-candidate staging; Practice-owned approval and publication remain separate
forbidden_dependencies: [knowledge-tree]
